Renaissance Golf Club

Haverhill, MA

The Course →

Welcome to Renaissance Golf Club, a private eighteen-hole club in Haverhill, MA. Situated on the Merrimack River, about 40 minutes outside Boston. Southworth founded in 1991, began with Willowbend in Cape Cod.

Our course.

Eighteen holes.

[renaissance golf club] noun — eighteen holes in Haverhill, mapped hole by hole from the air.
